fieldNotes.site: Kroger Springfield manufacturing campus; Delight Products is the grocery/snack-food production division at 1200 Industrial Dr. Audited the dominant secured plant/DC building (the fully perimeter-fenced south-east structure with the south dock band and SE drop yard).
fieldNotes.truckGate: Tall black ornamental perimeter fence wraps the whole property (confirmed in multiple Street View frames along the south/east roads). A sliding gate in the fence controls the access driveway at the SE.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No manned guard booth visible at the entrance; the structure that looked like a gatehouse in satellite resolved to a tall light pole + shadow. Controlled gate but no booth, so remoteGs=true. Low-confidence call.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock band on the south building face with trailers backed in; ~1M sq ft Kroger DC/plant, banded 50+ from building scale. Exact count not legible from overhead, hence band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Rows of drop trailers in the SE yard inside the fence; 25-50 visible band.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town Springfield TN with adjacent residential but open farmland to the east; judged Rural.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs along the SW property edge but no spur was seen entering the secured plant property; railServed=false.
